scope: All 108 fixed cases. Source construction + bounded encoding + decoding/verification +20Mbps serialization +20ms propagation +20ms clock +200ms action reserve; cold transport/proof setup and backlog paid. Worst of3 timings and5 coding repeats, not WCET. Each query/radius is a separate task, no free oracle selection. Synthetic perturbations share per-class random draws; not independent risk trials. Actual sensor/callback latency and physical links unmeasured. Same-partition loss is restricted to the inherited rule that rechecks only old excluded leaves. Old unresolved leaves remain possible; cold representation loss, all-leaf refinement and total optimality gap are not measured.
